derivedFiles.modifications: Reduced to page identity, selection fallback, event journaling, and deterministic disposal.
Removed MCP transport, emulation, and server response concerns; retained session ownership, page/snapshot access, text waiting, and page-scoped observation access.

Collapsed page-scoped snapshot, dialog, action, text-wait, and collector access into Piskie's session contract; observed dialogs remain recoverable even when a Puppeteer locator stays pending until timeout.
Removed DevTools-selected and third-party extra nodes; preserved Piskie's globally invalidated snapshot UID format.

Retains the upstream CDP navigation-start probe, navigation completion wait, stable-DOM sequence, and post-action error boundary; Promise.withResolvers, using syntax, logging, telemetry, and MCP response types were replaced with ES2022-compatible resolvers, explicit non-blocking handle disposal, and Piskie ActionReceipt values.
Retained the upstream valid-key set, validation timing, and combination parsing under the Piskie session API.
Adapted navigation to BrowserManager.runExclusive and structured Piskie results; omitted MCP schemas and response content.

Retained option, select, toggle, fill, click, hover, drag/drop, upload/file-chooser fallback, form-fill, action-error, and reverse modifier-release semantics behind Piskie's session API; option lookup traverses Chromium 148 accessibility wrapper nodes while preserving upstream text-to-DOM-value selection, and remote handles use explicit non-blocking disposal.

Adapted UID actions, drag, and upload to Piskie's camelCase browser names, output text, trusted workspace roots, and one-active-snapshot lifecycle; MCP handler dispatch and response objects were removed.
Kept browser page/navigation compatibility, exposed handleDialog, and replaced MCP handler dispatch with direct session calls.
Retained page/UID screenshot behavior, the two-megabyte temporary-file boundary, and non-blocking element-handle disposal without exposing unrestricted file paths.
Retained function-expression evaluation, JSON serialization, result text, and non-blocking function-handle disposal without MCP response types or element arguments.

Retained per-page stable IDs, main-frame navigation buckets, the three-navigation preservation window, the 1000-request cap, and navigation-request reassignment; DevTools issue aggregation was omitted and the previous Piskie pageerror observation was retained.

Retained concise/detailed console text, argument resolution, unavailable-argument markers, and consecutive-message grouping; DevTools source-map symbolization and aggregated issue formatting were omitted.

Retained concise/detailed request formatting, request and response body retrieval, UTF-8/binary detection, 10000-character truncation, failures, and redirect chains; body file writes, DevTools selection, and bundled DevTools header formatting were removed.
Retained page-size defaults, invalid-page fallback, indices, and page metadata under a transport-free helper.
Retained the upstream human-readable pagination lines without MCP Content or structuredContent response objects.
Retained canonical realpath resolution including nearest-existing-parent handling for path validation.
Adapted MCP root containment validation to the existing Piskie workspace and task temporary-directory owners; unrestricted-path mode was omitted.
Exposed waitFor with upstream any-text matching and post-wait snapshot text through Piskie's direct session adapter.
Adapted read-only list/get console handlers, filters, preserved-navigation selection, pagination, grouping, and output to Piskie's string-returning browser adapter.
Adapted read-only list/get network handlers, resource filters, preserved-navigation selection, pagination, and inline body output; body file path parameters and writes were removed.
Adapted drag and upload schemas to camelCase and supplied trusted workspace roots outside the model-visible schema.
Adapted handleDialog schema and descriptions to the trusted browser Skill contract.
Adapted waitFor schema and any-text semantics to the browser Skill contract.
Adapted read-only console list/get schemas and filter enums to camelCase browser names.
Adapted read-only network list/get schemas and removed body file-write parameters.
